Forge PNG CPU accelerator

Original Forge raster/unfilter/CRC/loader/build adapters: MIT.
The compiled bounded zlib/Adler decoder uses miniz tinfl3.1.1, commit d10b03cc73475af673df40f06e5cefd1d5f940d9.
Complete original miniz source, checksum manifest, license, exact umbrella-include adaptation and freestanding build recipe are supplied in scripts/media/png-decoder and build-png-decoder.py in corresponding source. No game or SDK code is embedded.
